newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' net oil import bill up by 9.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' net oil import bill up by 9.4 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' net oil import bill rose by 9.4 percent to $1.474 billion for the first seven months of the year from $1.347 billion in the same period in 1995, the energy department said on Thursday.
The department said in a report, a copy of which was given to Reuters, that total oil imports rose by 12.6 percent to $1.584 billion from January to July this year from $1.408 billion.
The Philippines exports naptha of which it has excess capacity.
Volume of imports reached 83.62 million barrels for the first seven months of this year from 77.48 million barrels.
Exports jumped by 82.6 percent to $110.4 million or 5.59 million barrels from $60.5 million or 3.28 million barrels. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418936 fax 8176267
